تغابيت (form VI)
# تَغَابَيْتُ (taḡābaytu) /ta.ɣaː.baj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَغَابَى (taḡābā)
# تَغَابَيْتَ (taḡābayta) /ta.ɣaː.baj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَغَابَى (taḡābā)
# تَغَابَيْتِ (taḡābayti) /ta.ɣaː.baj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَغَابَى (taḡābā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
